description: Re-promote a previous successful snapshot to https://{suffix}.novence.ai without a new upload. Pro/Scale only (HTTP 402 on Free). Omit deployment_id to restore the version live immediately before the current one (a second rollback undoes the first). The 5 most recently live versions are retained. HTML and unhashed CSS/JS use Cache-Control max-age=60 — hard-refresh or wait. Fingerprinted filenames stay cached. Does not run Lighthouse or increment deploys_count.

deployment_id.description: Specific deployment UUID. Omit to use the project's latest deployment.

project_id.description: Hosting project UUID from create_project or list_projects.
